strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
This is Zeon's secret base...? Aina is... here...!?
Lieutenant Amada! I didn't give the order to launch!
That's not like Shiro, he's usually so easygoing. Huh, Show?
Cham, don't say unnecessary things.
...Him too... with a Zeon pilot...?
Kamille, we're going. ...You know how dangerous that is... right?
...It's quiet.
The calm before the storm... as they say.
Going underground with Getter-2 might be best.
I'm gettin' chills.
(It sure looks like the kind of place he'd hide, but...)
So, Hazuki, where's the enemy?
Hm, probably straight north, around halfway up the mountain.
Huh? You don't know for sure?
Mike, quit being so demanding!
Let's just head north. We can't sit around like this...!
Lieutenant Amada, rushing won't produce good results.
Ngh... the Apsaras...!?
Aina...? Aina really is in that mobile armor...!?
Lieutenant Amada...! We're in combat!
...No... Captain Amuro, this is just... like with Four...!
Ainaaa! It's you, Aina Sahalin, isn't it!? Don't you remember!?
It's me! Shiro Amada! If you're alive, answer me!
...Way too hot-blooded, Lieutenant...! Akira, can't you cover him!?
No way! That big thing's about to fall!
...Shiro...
It really... really is Shiro Amada...!
You remember... I'm glad you're safe. I never thought we'd meet again.
Me too... (He's worried about me...)
Ah...! The unit's stability...!?
Ngh... the Apsaras...!?
A Federation local unit... all the way out here...
With Jaburo taken by someone, I thought they'd be in total collapse...
yet an army this strong still remains... But...!
That's...! Over there... Is that a Gundam!?
The Gundam Project... Prototype Unit 2...!
I thought that project had been canceled...!?
Major Gato... Please withdraw from here.
You must bring that machine back to space.
Five minutes until the rendezvous... I felt like having a little fun.
Major, I apologize...
Not at all, Colonel. It's nothing for you to worry about.
(The Apsaras Project, eh...
Using his own sister as a tool of war... I can't fathom Major General Ginias.)
That's...a Gundam? It sure looks rugged.
Isn't it just a bluff?
This is top secret, but... that unit carries nukes... Stay sharp!
...You've gotta be kidding me.
That Zaku-headed mobile armor... Is Aina...in that? Dammit, the comm...!
Lieutenant Amada! They'll intercept our comms! What are you doing...!?
Geez, I can't stand to watch this!
I do...understand how he feels, though.
Anyway, now we know this is Zeon's secret base,
so let's raise some hell and worry about Aina after that!
You're so easy to read. ...But I guess that's all we can do.
That's naive. Is Lieutenant Amada really a soldier?
Tetsuya's totally clueless about that stuff. He doesn't get love.
There's no need for that sort of thing in battle.
Lady Aina, if the situation turns against us... please retreat.
If you die, everything will be for nothing.
I have told Lord Ginias the same thing. ...I beg you.
...I'll do as you say, Norris.
Then...here I go!
Aina... Ainaaa!
Lieutenant Amada!?
What the heck's gotten into that lieutenant!?
That all happened in a flash. What's goin' on!?
Lieutenant! Lieutenant Amada! Respond! Get back here!
Show, can't you go after him!?
We can't make it in time from here...!
Lieutenant Amada! That's reckless...!
No way... Shiro. Where'd you go...? Shirooo!
Hmph, this is as far as I go...! I didn't expect them to be this good...
The Gandor Team, was it? They move well. We're pulling out!
He's running!? Dammit, wait!
Gundam Unit 2 is mine!
If we should meet again... it will be in space.
And know that it will be your end!
No doubt about it... The Nightmare of Solomon... Major Anavel Gato!
Wiseman, pursuing him too far is dangerous!
Problem after problem... Dammit, we're stretched too thin...!
Grrr, my... my Apsaras...!
If only the finished model had been ready in time...!
Lord Ginias, you must escape...! This place won't hold much longer...!
...It galls me to obey that masked man... but it can't be helped...!
Just what I'd expect of the Gandor Team...
They're trying to escape!
Like hell I'll let you!
Lord Ginias, hurry!
Fuhahaha, that's what makes you worthy opponents for my Apsaras...
Hmph, this is as far as I go...! I didn't expect them to be this good...
The Gandor Team, was it? They move well. We're pulling out!
He's running!? Dammit, wait!
Gundam Unit 2 is mine!
If we should meet again... it will be in space.
And know that it will be your end!
No doubt about it... The Nightmare of Solomon... Major Anavel Gato!
Wiseman, pursuing him too far is dangerous!
Problem after problem... Dammit, we're stretched too thin...!
Huh? Reinforcements?
Hahahaha, well done finding this place, Gandor Team.
Brother!?
Showing your face so carelessly... I'll knock you flat!
I'll let no one stand in the way of my dream!
Lord Ginias...!?
Weren't you to withdraw while we kept the Gandor busy?
I wanted to feel the Gandor Team's power for myself.
But if you should lose your life!
I know when to pull back.
That's why I have you and Aina, Colonel, isn't it?
Is it...over?
So it seems.
It's practically the HQ of Zeon's ground forces.
Now... we can focus on the aliens and the mystery army...
Now we just gotta trash that bastard Dr. Hell and the Demon Empire,
and we can breathe easy for now.
I don't think it's that simple, Koji.
I don't think it'll be that easy, Commander.
Yes... Neo Zeon's main force is in space...
We'll have no choice but to leave that showdown to Londo Bell...
What about Lieutenant Amada!? Commander Hazuki, where is he...!?
...We've lost his ID signal.
Residual Minovsky particles are dense... We're leaving here for now.
We're not searching for the lieutenant!?
...His actions were a breach of military regulations.
We've dealt with Zeon's ground forces, but many enemies remain...
So you're just abandoning him!? That's too harsh, Commander!
Right, not understanding a heart in love is just so tactless...
That's enough, both of you. The one hurting most...
is Commander Hazuki, who has to make that call.
Then... unless the lieutenant returns on his own, or makes contact...
...the Gandor Team heads for Jaburo as planned. No objections.
Commander Hazuki...
...I couldn't stop him...! It's just like with Four...!
Kamille...
Aina... I thought I'd see you again, just once more...
Lieutenant Amada... in battle, those feelings are dangerous.
And...they rarely lead anywhere good.
...I know. But...!
Lieutenant Amada. ...It's harsh, but you're confined to the study room.
You understand why...don't you?
...Yes, sir.
Hey, Show, why is that a bad thing?
This is wrong. I mean...
Cham, stop. There are all kinds of problems. All kinds...
